name: agribangla
description: AgriBangla (কৃষিবাংলা) — MERN stack agricultural guidance app: React client + Express/MongoDB API with Gemini-powered কৃষকবন্ধু AI and TCB market prices.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,yellow "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
